name: Ancient Of Days
overview: The title 'Ancient of Days' is a distinctive appellation of Jehovah, emphasizing His eternal nature and sovereign authority as depicted in Daniel 7. In this vision, the Ancient of Days is portrayed with white garments and hair, symbolizing purity and timelessness, seated on a fiery throne signifying divine judgment and power. This figure presides over the arrival of the Son of Man and the ultimate granting of judgment to the saints, affirming God's role as the eternal judge and king who establishes His kingdom through Christ.
